en: Scope the sandbox policy to each Session instead of one process-wide singleton, restore the session tool policy when a turn ends, and copy mutable runtime data so later configuration changes cannot alter an existing snapshot.
zh-CN: 沙箱策略改为按 Session 作用域，不再使用进程级单例；turn 结束时恢复 session 的工具策略；复制可变运行时数据，避免后续配置修改影响已创建的快照。
